Agad inaksyunan ng Quezon City Government, sa pangunguna ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), ang reklamong ipinadala ng isang concerned QCitizen hinggil sa illegal parking sa Don Damaso St. Brgy. Holy Spirit.

Inalis at inisyuhan ng Ordinance Violation Receipt (OVR) ticket ang mga sasakyang iligal na nakaparada sa daan at iba pang mga sagabal sa kalsada.

Hinikayat din ang Homeowners Association (HOA) sa lugar na magpatupad ng "No Parking on Both Sides" policy upang mapanatiling maayos at ligtas ang lansangan.

Para sa agarang aksyon kaugnay ng kaparehong concern, ipagbigay-alam ito sa amin o tumawag lamang sa Helpline 122.

Maraming salamat po.

🎟️ Jet2Puppies Stamp Rally 🐾

Ayooo, Jet2Puppies attendees! Join our stamp rally tomorrow for a chance to enter the Grand Raffle! 💙

How to join:
1️⃣ Claim your stamp rally card at the registration area.
2️⃣ Complete all three activities and collect the required stamp stickers.
3️⃣ Write your name in the two spaces provided on the card.
4️⃣ During the designated program time, present your completed card to the staff for verification.
5️⃣ Once verified, the staff will tear off the upper portion of your card as your raffle entry. You will keep the remaining part.

✅ Only fully completed cards will be accepted for the raffle.

Have fun exploring the island stops and good luck, puppies! 🏝️✨

Note: After completing the museum part, take a screenshot of your post and show it to the YVPH staff as proof during the finalization of the stamp rally.

#Jet2Puppies
#BANGYUNHA #방윤하
#UNIS #유니스
